source.title: Void-free Copper Electrodeposition in High Aspect Ratio, Full Wafer Thickness Through-Silicon Vias with Endpoint Detection

conditions.bath_optimized: 1 mol/L CuSO4 + 0.5 mol/L H2SO4 + 80 umol/L KCl + 40 umol/L Tetronic 701 (LOW Cl)
conditions.bath_failed: 1.25 mol/L CuSO4 + 0.25 M MSA + 1 mmol/L KCl + 50 umol/L T701: 10:1 vias fully suppressed at -0.62 V, voided at -0.64 V (window too narrow at AR10)
conditions.hydrodynamics: 400 rpm helicopter rotation; -18 C IPA vacuum prewet
conditions.vias: 62.5 um dia x 625 um deep (AR10), ALD Pt seed, 625 um full-thickness Si

data.note: 5:1 vias (125x600) in MSA bath: -0.60 sporadic, -0.62 seam voids, -0.64 VOID-FREE, -0.70 keyhole

data.result: deposition initiates at bottom / center / top respectively; current decays ~1 h (Tetronic diffusion time scale ~1 h)

data.steps: -500 to -560 mV MSE in 10 mV increments; 2 h per step EXCEPT step 5 (-540 mV) extended to 5 h
data.outcome: VOID-FREE by cross-section AND X-ray CT (5 um resolution)

competing_protocols.outcome: minor seam voids near top (CT only)

competing_protocols.steps: 2 h with step-5 extended to 5 h

data.observation: current local minimum marks deposition completion; subsequent rise = field overplating

data.note: their Fig 5: samples stopped after steps 2,5,6,7 of the 2 h/10 mV protocol show bottom-up initiation, v-shaped front by step 5, seam void by step 7

notes: Priority paper from user list. AR10 counterpart to Menk 2019. KEY: 17 h total with 5 h dwell at -540 mV for void-free AR10 fill (matches KB v1.4 '5 h hold at the critical step, 17-19 h'). Directly supports the KB staged-ramp recipe shape (long dwell at the critical step, finish at lower rpm per their Fig 7f). Endpoint = current minimum is a cheap in-situ observable for platesim. Note KB §5 cites this as '17-19 h' from poster; paper confirms 17 h for the void-free variant.
